Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Abrar Ali, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C., it was alleged that for the last 1-/12 years, the applicant and the victim was in love relationship allegedly on the false pretext of marriage, physical relations were also formed over a long span of time,
subsequently the applicant did not honour the commitment of marriage.
In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that under the family pressure, the case was got registered and nothing wrong was done to the victim.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated Mohd. Kaif vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

1 that around 7-8 months ago the applicant had formed physical relations with the victim under the false pretext of marriage.
3. The counsel for the applicant and the counsel for the informant state that the applicant and victim are willing to marry.
4. Learned A.G.A. as well as the counsel for the informant opposed the bail prayer.
5. Considering the statement on record, prima facie, the victim is aged about 20 years and the relationship continued in between the applicant and the victim over a span of 1-1/2 years.
Considering all these fact coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 03.08.2024 is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
